svg.title: Priority Queue
svg.desc: Priority Queue. Urgent messages are processed ahead of routine ones. Step 1, First come, first served: One queue: a password reset waits behind 500 re-index jobs. At 10 jobs a second, that is 50 s. Step 2, A queue per priority: Two queues, high checked first: the reset email is picked up at once and sent in about 0.5 s. Step 3, Starvation, then reserve: A flash sale floods high and low starves for 10 min. Reserve a worker for low; scale high out. Step 4, Know the limits: Brokers differ, priority never pre-empts, and if every producer says urgent, nothing is.

Flash sale: 12 urgent orders/s arrive; the pool finishes 10/s.
High-first polling: high is never empty, so low gets nothing.
Scale each pool on its own queue: high grows to 6 workers, 15 jobs/s.
RabbitMQ: yes, in classic and quorum queues.
SQS, Service Bus, Pub/Sub, Kafka: no; use a queue, subscription or topic per level.
